description: Official economic forecasts for a country or region from the IMF World Economic Outlook and the OECD Economic Outlook: GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, current account, government balance and debt by default; also, by `indicator`, core inflation, short and long interest rates, GDP in US dollars and per head, population, export and import volumes. Each publisher's latest edition comes with the earlier editions it revised, and every answer names the edition. Values for the publication year and after are the publisher's forecasts. `area` takes a country name, an ISO-3 code or a region code (WLD, EA, EU, G7, ADV, EMDE, ASEAN5, OECD); `year` narrows to one year.
name: get_forecasts
title: Get forecasts
